ref_entities: run the unittest suite for google.protobuf.internal.descriptor to verify descriptor construction and fixups
test simple and complex custom options on protobuf file, message, field, enum, service, and method descriptors
test CopyToProto on message, enum, file, and service descriptors to verify proto serialization
test descriptor.MakeDescriptor to build a Descriptor from a DescriptorProto with unsigned int fields
test aggregate options embedded in file, message, field, enum, service, and method descriptors
run the GeneratorTest unittest suite to verify pure-Python protocol compiler output
test that nested message descriptors match field message_type references in protobuf
test module-level and message-scoped enum values generated by the protobuf compiler
test extension range descriptors for protobuf messages with multiple extension ranges
test that public imports expose messages correctly across protobuf modules
test parsing and serializing a golden protobuf message with all field types set
test pickling and unpickling a protobuf message to verify round-trip equality
test sorting repeated scalar fields like int32, float, and string with default comparator
test sorting repeated composite message fields using a custom comparator or key function
test that required and optional fields merge while repeated fields accumulate on parse
test the FooUnitTest class to verify protobuf service reflection works with mock RPC channels
test the TestService_Stub to verify RPC stub method invocation and descriptor access
create a MockRpcChannel subclass of service.RpcChannel that captures method calls and invokes callbacks
create a MockRpcController subclass of service.RpcController that records failure messages via SetFailed
run the unittest test suite for google.protobuf.internal.service_reflection using unittest.main
set all non-lazy fields on a protobuf TestAllTypes message to unique test values
set all fields including lazy ones on a protobuf message to unique test values
set all extension fields on a protobuf TestAllExtensions message to unique test values
verify all fields of a protobuf message have the expected values after SetAllFields
set all packed repeated fields on a protobuf TestPackedTypes message to unique test values
test the text_format MessageToString function to serialize a protobuf message into human-readable text format
test the text_format Merge function to parse human-readable text back into a protobuf message object
test the text_format MessageToString with as_one_line flag to print nested messages on a single line
test the text_format MessageToString with as_utf8 flag to output raw UTF-8 bytes instead of octal escapes
test that text_format Merge raises ParseError when given invalid text such as unknown fields or bad enum values
test the PackTag function to encode a field number and wire type into a protobuf tag
test the UnpackTag function to decode a protobuf tag into its field number and wire type
test the ZigZagEncode function to encode signed integers for efficient varint serialization
test the ZigZagDecode function to decode zigzag-encoded integers back to signed values
test all numeric ByteSize functions to calculate wire format byte sizes for protobuf fields
